Be concise, concrete, and Slack-ready. No preamble, no markdown headers, no JSON — 2 to 3 sentences of prose only.

Be concise, concrete, and Slack-ready. No preamble, no markdown headers, no JSON — 2 to 3 sentences of prose only.

parameters.text:
=Analyze DEPENDENCIES for today's blocked items.

Blocked items:
{{ $('Validate + Count').first().json.records.filter(r => r.status === 'Blocked').map(r => [r.itemId, r.feature, 'Owner: ' + r.owner, r.description].join(' | ')).join('\n') }}

In 2-3 sentences: what each blocked item appears to be waiting on to unblock, and any cross-item dependency that affects sequencing.

messageValues.message: You are a dependency analyst for a product team. Given the blocked items and their descriptions, identify what each is waiting on to unblock, and any cross-item dependency that affects sequencing. Be concise, concrete, and Slack-ready. No preamble, no markdown headers, no JSON — 2 to 3 sentences of prose only.

parameters.text:
=You are the router for a roadmap-digest pipeline. Work in two steps.

STEP 1 — Identify the high-priority picture:
High-priority items ({{ $('Validate + Count').first().json.highCount }}):
{{ $('Validate + Count').first().json.records.filter(r => r.priority === 'High').map(r => [r.itemId, r.feature, 'Status: ' + r.status, r.description].join(' | ')).join('\n') }}
Blocked among them: {{ $('Validate + Count').first().json.blockedIds.join(', ') }}

STEP 2 — Decide the route:
Looking only at the high-priority items above, do any of them have a dependency worth untangling before the digest is written — i.e. a blocker involving a review, another team, or a prerequisite item?
- If YES, at least one high-priority item has such a dependency: respond YES (route to deeper dependency analysis).
- If NO, every high-priority item is clear and self-contained: respond NO (go straight to the summary).

Respond with only one word: YES or NO.

messageValues.message: You are the supervisor of a roadmap-digest pipeline. Your only job is to decide whether a deeper DEPENDENCY analysis of the blocked items is warranted before the digest is written. This is a judgment call, not a count. Answer with a single word only: YES or NO.
